reason: Operationalize the protocol's participant token and window index after a label-free technical preflight passed for all 35 publisher-eligible E4 participants; no model scores or inferential outcomes have been computed.

identity_and_window_rules.participant_folder_set: p01 through p37 excluding publisher-documented missing-data participants p14 and p23; require all four E4 channels, exact native rates, and predeclared window eligibility.
identity_and_window_rules.participant_token: first 16 lowercase hex characters of SHA256(UTF-8('neurostress_ssl_external_v1|' + lowercase participant folder name)); this token is the participant-level inference/output unit.
identity_and_window_rules.window_index: zero-based sequential index of complete non-overlapping 10-second windows from the exactly aligned common E4 recording start; discard only the incomplete trailing segment.
identity_and_window_rules.fault_seed: Use the unchanged structured_faults_v3 string structured_faults_v3|{participant_token}|{window_index}|{family}|{modality}; derive the seed from the first eight lowercase SHA256 hex characters as an unsigned integer.
identity_and_window_rules.fault_cells: Score one unmodified control and all nonzero-dose single-modality family × severity × target cells. Pair cells remain secondary and are not part of primary inference.
identity_and_window_rules.window_denominator: For each target modality, risk and coverage use all sampled windows whose fixed structured fault has nonzero dose; average within the target modality, then give the four target modalities equal weight.
identity_and_window_rules.model_seed_zero_rule: A participant/model-seed/modality with zero retained nonzero-dose primary windows makes that participant/SSL-score primary contrast non-estimable under the frozen joint rule.

unchanged: frozen WESAD-only SSL and hybrid models, calibration, and thresholds
risk contrasts, bootstrap/sign-flip procedures, Holm adjustment, and five-point coverage margin
no labels, task predictions, human ratings, target training, target normalization, calibration or threshold fitting
synthetic-fault-only interpretation and all predeclared limitations
